title: subagent.dispatch/v1 request
description: Fan out bounded read-only sub-analyses within the current Run and collect their conclusions. Sub-agents never receive write, effect, or interaction capabilities.

objective.description: What the primary agent is trying to decide by fanning out. Recorded on the ToolCall for audit.

branches.description: Independent sub-analyses. They cannot see each other and cannot dispatch further.

key.description: Stable identifier used to correlate the branch with its result.

capabilities.description: Read-only capabilities this branch may use. Must be a subset of the primary agent's own read capabilities; anything else is rejected.
